user_instruction: 改好觉得可行了，就house123，1seed验证；如果这都不行，就不要多seed验证
seed_interpretation: Previously authorized spent seed; development screen, not fresh held-out proof
on_valid_screen_no_go: Preserve all results; do not launch any multi-seed batch
on_screen_pass: Report results first; no automatic multi-seed expansion
on_runtime_failure: Mark INVALID separately from scientific NO_GO; preserve attempt artifacts
launch_preconditions: M1 source-strength and error model implemented and frozen
M2 causal online input, boundary and startup-history contracts qualified
Wind reconstruction and navigation/source propagation use explicitly compatible geometry; successful service return alone is not proof that a wind observation was inserted
Wind solver update/convergence status and temporal prediction are checked; finite full-field means alone do not qualify a transport posterior
Native field-frame duration and any seeded replay seam physically qualified; do not assume cyclic archival frames are continuous transport
Same-input core/runtime parity and ROS build pass
Same-controller comparison and exact code/binary identity frozen
evidence_boundary: Local core tests and sensor replay do not authorize claims of closed-loop benefit
batch_rules: No tuning after launch, no losing-House removal, no seed replacement to rescue outcomes
